He argued that while younger generations may appear different from previous generations, their honesty and openness about emotions are similar.  **Dr Rimpa Sarkar**, a mental health expert, agreed that core emotional needs remain constant across generations but Gen Z approaches these needs differently, emphasizing emotional awareness, boundaries, and compatibility. She also highlighted the impact of technology on dating culture, noting increased access to potential partners while simultaneously creating pressure and unrealistic expectations.

recent_articles.title: Versatile actor Salim Kumar passes away aged 57 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Salim Kumar**, a National Award-winning actor, writer, director, and mimicry artiste, passed away on June 6th at the age of 57 from cardiac arrest while receiving treatment.  He had been hospitalized with fever and shortness of breath earlier that morning and was placed on ventilator support. **Kumar**'s funeral will be held in his hometown of North Paravur on Sunday following public homage at his home. He leaves behind a legacy as a talented artist who achieved success in the film industry, despite facing health challenges throughout his life.
